Description: Gated Nutraxin paid-order receipts: AWS SES production access and exact Stripe payment reconciliation required. Off by default.

NotificationsEnabled.Description: Owner-controlled release gate. Default false; no schedule is created.

"""Private, opt-in Nutraxin PAID-order receipt dispatcher. Never invoked from a public URL. No customer emails are stored in DynamoDB. Review-only deployment by default: NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED is false until SES production access, sender authentication and paid-order acceptance pass. """ import json from html import escape import os import re import time import urllib.error import urllib.parse import urllib.request import boto3 from botocore.exceptions import ClientError REGION = os.environ.get("AWS_REGION", "eu-north-1") ENABLED = os.environ.get("NOTIFICATIONS_ENABLED", "false") == "true" LEDGER = os.environ["PAYMENT_LEDGER_TABLE"] OUTBOX = os.environ["PAYMENT_OUTBOX_TABLE"] STRIPE_SECRET = os.environ["STRIPE_API_KEY_SECRET_ID"] SENDER = os.environ["EMAIL_SENDER"] DDB = boto3.client("dynamodb", region_name=REGION) SECRETS = boto3.client("secretsmanager", region_name=REGION) SES = boto3.client("sesv2", region_name=REGION) SESSION = re.compile(r"^cs_live_[A-Za-z0-9]+$") ORDER = re.compile(r"^NUT-[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-4[0-9a-f]{3}-[89ab][0-9a-f]{3}-[0-9a-f]{12}$") EVENT = re.compile(r"^evt_[A-Za-z0-9]+$") EMAIL = re.compile(r"^[^\s@<>]{1,64}@[^\s@<>]{1,180}$") def field(row, name, kind="S"): return (row.get(name) or {}).get(kind) def response(status, **values): return {"statusCode": status, "body": json.dumps(values, separators=(",", ":"))} def eligible(event): if field(event, "eventType") != "NUTRAXIN_PAYMENT_PAID": return None if field(event, "status") != "PENDING_REVIEW": return None key = event.get("pk", {}).get("S", "") order_id = key.removeprefix("ORDER#") if key.startswith("ORDER#") else "" sk = event.get("sk", {}).get("S", "") event_id = sk.removeprefix("PAYMENT_EVENT#") if sk.startswith("PAYMENT_EVENT#") else "" if not ORDER.fullmatch(order_id) or not EVENT.fullmatch(event_id): return None attempt_id = field(event, "paymentAttemptId") if not attempt_id or len(attempt_id) > 160: return None return order_id, event_id, attempt_id def read_paid_order(order_id, event_id): row = DDB.get_item(TableName=LEDGER, Key={ "pk": {"S": "ORDER#" + order_id}, "sk": {"S": "SUMMARY"} }, ConsistentRead=True).get("Item") or {} sid = field(row, "stripeSessionId") amount = field(row, "totalGrossMinor", "N") if (field(row, "orderId") != order_id or field(row, "status") != "PAID" or field(row, "lastStripeEventId") != event_id or not isinstance(sid, str) or not SESSION.fullmatch(sid) or not isinstance(amount, str) or not amount.isdecimal() or not 30 <= int(amount) <= 99999999 or field(row, "currency") != "GBP"): raise ValueError("Order is not a verified paid Nutraxin checkout") return row, sid, int(amount) def stripe_session(sid): token = (SECRETS.get_secret_value(SecretId=STRIPE_SECRET).get("SecretString") or "").strip() if not token.startswith(("rk_live_", "sk_live_")) or "\n" in token or "\r" in token: raise ValueError("Stripe read credential not configured") url = "https://api.stripe.com/v1/checkout/sessions/" + urllib.parse.quote(sid, safe="") req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"Authorization": "Bearer " + token, "Accept": "application/json"}, method="GET") with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=8) as res: return json.loads(res.read(131072)) def verified_recipient(session, row, sid, order_id, attempt_id, amount): metadata = session.get("metadata") or {} if (session.get("id") != sid or session.get("livemode") is not True or session.get("mode") != "payment" or session.get("status") != "complete" or session.get("payment_status") != "paid" or session.get("currency") != "gbp" or session.get("amount_total") != amount or session.get("client_reference_id") != order_id or metadata.get("payment_attempt_id") != attempt_id or metadata.get("quote_version") != field(row, "quoteVersion") or metadata.get("customer_id") != field(row, "customerId")): raise ValueError("Stripe payment does not reconcile to the durable order") details = session.get("customer_details") or {} address = details.get("email") or session.get("customer_email") if not isinstance(address, str) or len(address) > 254 or not EMAIL.fullmatch(address): raise ValueError("Stripe confirmed email is unavailable") return address def claim(order_id, event_id): DDB.update_item(TableName=OUTBOX, Key={"pk": {"S": "ORDER#" + order_id}, "sk": {"S": "PAYMENT_EVENT#" + event_id}}, UpdateExpression="SET #s = :claim, claimedAt = :now", ConditionExpression="#s = :pending", ExpressionAttributeNames={"#s": "status"}, ExpressionAttributeValues={ ":claim": {"S": "SENDING"}, ":pending": {"S": "PENDING_REVIEW"}, ":now": {"N": str(int(time.time()))}}) def mark(order_id, event_id, status, message_id=None): values={":prev": {"S": "SENDING"}, ":status": {"S": status}, ":when": {"N": str(int(time.time()))}} update="SET #s = :status, processedAt = :when" if message_id: values[":id"]={"S": message_id} update += ", sesMessageId = :id" DDB.update_item(TableName=OUTBOX, Key={"pk": {"S": "ORDER#" + order_id}, "sk": {"S": "PAYMENT_EVENT#" + event_id}}, UpdateExpression=update, ConditionExpression="#s = :prev", ExpressionAttributeNames={"#s": "status"}, ExpressionAttributeValues=values) LOGO_URL = "https://novapharmhealthcare.com/assets/brand/novapharm-healthcare-logo.png" TRACK_URL = "https://novapharmhealthcare.com/products/track/" SUPPORT = "support@novapharmhealthcare.com" def gbp(minor): return f"£{minor // 100:,}.{minor % 100:02d}" def receipt_lines(row, amount): lines = json.loads(field(row, "approvedLinesJson") or "[]") shipping_raw = field(row, "shippingGrossMinor", "N") if not isinstance(shipping_raw, str) or not shipping_raw.isdecimal(): raise ValueError("Verified shipping amount missing") shipping = int(shipping_raw) if not isinstance(lines, list) or not 1 <= len(lines) <= 100: raise ValueError("Verified order lines missing") cleaned = [] for line in lines: if not isinstance(line, dict): raise ValueError("Invalid order line") name, qty, gross = line.get("name"), line.get("quantity"), line.get("grossMinor") if (not isinstance(name, str) or not 1 <= len(name) <= 200 or any(ord(c) < 32 for c in name) or type(qty) is not int or not 1 <= qty <= 10000 or type(gross) is not int or not 0 <= gross <= amount): raise ValueError("Invalid approved order line") cleaned.append((name, qty, gross)) if sum(line[2] for line in cleaned) + shipping != amount: raise ValueError("Order lines do not reconcile to payment") return cleaned, shipping def receipt_content(order_id, amount, lines, shipping): subject = "Thank you for your order." intro = "Your payment has been received. Thank you for choosing NovaPharm." follow = "We will be in touch when your order is ready for dispatch. Payment confirmation does not mean your order has been dispatched." plain_lines = [f"{name} | Quantity: {qty} | {gbp(gross)}" for name, qty, gross in lines] body = "\n".join(["NovaPharm Healthcare", "", "Your order is confirmed.", "", intro, follow, "", "Order reference: " + order_id, "", *plain_lines, "Delivery: " + gbp(shipping), "Total paid (including applicable VAT): " + gbp(amount), "", "Check order status (no account required): " + TRACK_URL, "Enter the complete order reference above. This service shows status only.", "", "At your service.", "For assistance, reply to this email or contact " + SUPPORT + ".", "With care,", "NovaPharm Healthcare Ltd"]) rows = "".join( f'' f'{escape(name)}
Quantity: {qty}' f'{gbp(gross)}' for name, qty, gross in lines) html = f"""{subject}

Your order is confirmed.

{intro}

{follow}

Order reference

{escape(order_id)}

Your selection.

{rows}
Delivery{gbp(shipping)}
Total paid{gbp(amount)}

Includes applicable VAT.

Check your order status →

No account required. Enter your complete order reference to view the recorded status.

At your service.

If you have any questions about your order, simply reply to this email. We would be pleased to assist.

With care,
NovaPharm Healthcare

Customer care

{SUPPORT}

Order status

NovaPharm Healthcare Ltd
United Kingdom

""" return subject, body, html def send_receipt(address, order_id, amount, lines, shipping): subject, body, html = receipt_content(order_id, amount, lines, shipping) return SES.send_email( FromEmailAddress="NovaPharm Healthcare <" + SENDER + ">", ReplyToAddresses=[SUPPORT], Destination={"ToAddresses": [address]}, Content={"Simple": { "Subject": {"Data": subject, "Charset": "UTF-8"}, "Body": {"Text": {"Data": body, "Charset": "UTF-8"}, "Html": {"Data": html, "Charset": "UTF-8"}}}}) def handler(event, context): if not ENABLED: return response(200, enabled=False, processed=0) if (not isinstance(event, dict) or event.get("source") != "aws.events" or event.get("detail-type") != "Scheduled Event"): return response(403, error="scheduler_only") status = SES.get_account() if status.get("ProductionAccessEnabled") is not True or status.get("SendingEnabled") is not True: return response(503, error="ses_production_access_not_approved") if SENDER.split("@")[-1].lower() != "novapharmhealthcare.com": return response(503, error="sender_domain_unapproved") records = [] cursor = None scan_incomplete = False # DynamoDB applies Limit BEFORE FilterExpression, so paginate or new # paid events can be hidden behind older nonmatching outbox entries. for page in range(250): options = {"TableName": OUTBOX, "ConsistentRead": True, "Limit": 100, "FilterExpression": "#s = :pending AND eventType = :paid", "ExpressionAttributeNames": {"#s": "status"}, "ExpressionAttributeValues": {":pending": {"S": "PENDING_REVIEW"}, ":paid": {"S": "NUTRAXIN_PAYMENT_PAID"}}} if cursor: options["ExclusiveStartKey"] = cursor scanned = DDB.scan(**options) records.extend(scanned.get("Items", [])) cursor = scanned.get("LastEvaluatedKey") if not cursor or len(records) >= 25: break else: scan_incomplete = bool(cursor) records = records[:25] sent = 0 review = 0 for outbox in records: ids = eligible(outbox) if not ids: continue order_id, event_id, attempt_id = ids try: row, sid, amount = read_paid_order(order_id, event_id) session = stripe_session(sid) recipient = verified_recipient(session, row, sid, order_id, attempt_id, amount) lines, shipping = receipt_lines(row, amount) except (ClientError, urllib.error.HTTPError, urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, ValueError, KeyError, TypeError, json.JSONDecodeError): review += 1 continue try: claim(order_id, event_id) except ClientError: continue # Already claimed; never send again. try: delivered = send_receipt(recipient, order_id, amount, lines, shipping) except ClientError: mark(order_id, event_id, "REVIEW_REQUIRED") review += 1 continue # If marking SENT fails after SES success, SENDING is deliberately # stranded for manual reconciliation; automatic retries could duplicate mail. mark(order_id, event_id, "SENT", delivered.get("MessageId")) sent += 1 return response(200, enabled=True, sent=sent, needs_review=review, scan_incomplete=scan_incomplete)
